migration.name: 20260822164000_subject_agnostic_scheduling_and_resources
migration.backfill: Expand CareAppointment and CareIntakePacket with nullable subject columns, backfill every existing root as patient-profile:<patientProfileId>, reconcile, then require validated subject identity and conditionally require the clinical tuple. Generic intake children move to packet+organization joins while consent and coverage retain patient-composite joins. Hospitality resources and availability are idempotently copied to Resource and ResourceAvailability by deterministic Hospitality* sourceRef, with blocked state kept active and unknown legacy vocabulary retained in lifecycleReason/reason. No legacy row, clinical invariant field, evidence row, policy, or compatibility table is deleted. Rollback is source-only while roots remain patient-profile; restoring former clinical NOT NULL constraints requires a no-non-patient-row preflight.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: The existing restricted clinical record remains authoritative and keeps recall, controlled-overbooking authorization, preparation/recovery footprints, optimistic versioning, and status evidence. Existing rows become explicit patient-profile subjects. Non-patient roots may omit clinical relations, but no writer or access policy for them is introduced in this gate.

fields.reason: A validated open slug selects the owning identity domain without creating a second appointment authority.
fields.fieldPolicy: Restricted with the appointment record. Accept only lowercase validated slugs; expose no generic lookup endpoint and authorize through the owning vertical before any future non-patient write.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: The restricted packet remains the intake authority. Generic evidence joins by tenant-safe packet identity and keeps optional patient provenance; consent and coverage remain patient-specific. Existing retention, legal hold, append-only evidence, patient-token RLS, and purpose-bound staff-review RLS are unchanged.
